text: Recruiting first member: had to gift Katie White (Lowerham) 20x10 coins (200 coins, all my money) to reach Loyal before Invite enabled; Season box then shows 'Food: 15 of 14 for winter, 8 rotting'. Before any pawn member the Season box shows no food line at all for a ruler with a settlement.

Food fell from 'Food: 15 of 14 for winter, 6 rotting' (tick 168263, autumn night) to 'Food: 1 of 14' at winter day 1 (tick 173647) with no chronicle/status saying where it went (member Katie White is Glutton, Greedy). The 'stocked' reading on the eve of winter was not honest: the store vanished in ~5000 ticks. Famine line shown correctly.

Inside the camp at winter day 1: Katie White became the stall's merchant ('merchants: Katie White'), stall 0 for sale, settlement funds 12 coins. Likely her winter apples went through the stall I built; nothing told me that building a stall lets a member trade away her winter store.

Winter day 1 banner: 'Lowerburg: 1 member hungry: outside the walls. Bring food home and Feed Residents.' It does not name the hungry member (only one member, Katie White) nor where she is; the 'outside the walls' advice cannot be acted on - there is no way to feed or summon a member outside. Also Inventory box drawn mid-screen overlapping the world here.

Ruler with 29 apples cannot hand them to a member before she is hungry: the settlement screen has no Feed Residents / deposit option while Katie is not hungry ('Stockpile: empty' with no way to fill it), while her own store goes through the stall (settlement funds 12 -> 58 coins). 'Food: 1 of 14' can't be raised by a well-stocked ruler.

Winter day 2 (tick ~222000): banner says 'Lowerburg: 1 member hungry, 1 starving: in the Camp of Lowerburg. Bring food home and Feed Residents.' I carry 22 apples and entered the camp, but the settlement screen shows no Feed Residents button anywhere. The banner's advice cannot be followed; banner also does not name the member (Katie White).
